title: Existence of embedded immortal solutions for higher-order area-preserving curvature flows
statement: Let $m\geq1$. Consider the area-preserving curvature flow of order $m$ for embedded initial curves with length $L_0$ and enclosed area $1$. **Immortal-solution conjecture.** For every $L_0\geq\sqrt{4\pi}$, there exists an embedded initial curve $\gamma_0$ of length $L_0$ and enclosed area $1$ such that the solution starting from $\gamma_0$ is immortal. This extends the corresponding property known for the $m=0$ area-preserving curve-shortening flow; for $m\geq1$, convexity is not preserved, so a substantially new method beyond the nearly circular regime is required.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06183

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Tatsuya Miura, “Asymptotic circularity of immortal area-preserving curvature flows”, arXiv:2410.06183 (2024).
